Comparison

Accountium vs. QuickBooks Online

By Accountium Team  ·  Updated July 2026  ·  ⏱ 6 min read

Both products handle the accounting basics — invoicing, bank feeds, reporting. The differences that actually matter for most small businesses come down to three things: how payroll is priced, how the interface holds together as a suite, and what switching looks like if you're already in QuickBooks.

This page covers each honestly. Accountium wins on some dimensions and QuickBooks on others. The goal is to give you enough to decide — not to sell you on a predetermined conclusion.

Where Accountium Wins

The clearest advantages come down to pricing structure and how the product holds together as a single suite.

  • Payroll without the add-on tax

    QuickBooks sells payroll as a separate paid tier on top of your subscription. In Accountium, payroll runs, direct deposit, and tax filings are part of the core product — one login, one bill, no upsell path to unlock the feature you actually need.

  • One suite, not a bundle of upsells

    Invoicing, banking, payroll, and reporting live in a single interface built to work together. You're not navigating a base product with a menu of paid add-ons layered on top.

  • Built for how you actually work

    Real-time bank feed categorization and a mobile experience that mirrors the desktop app, so you're not stuck waiting for sync or hunting for a feature that only exists on one platform.

  • Multi-currency on every plan

    QuickBooks reserves multi-currency for higher tiers. In Accountium, it's included — no upgrade required to invoice or report in USD, EUR, GBP, or 30+ other currencies.

Where QuickBooks Is the Safer Bet

Honest assessment: QuickBooks has real advantages that are worth weighing depending on your situation.

A bigger ecosystem QuickBooks has been around far longer and has a much larger marketplace of third-party integrations and a bigger network of accountants and bookkeepers already fluent in it. If your bookkeeper specifically works in QuickBooks, or you depend on a niche integration, that's a real switching cost worth weighing.
  • 750+ third-party app integrations
  • Large certified ProAdvisor network
  • Longer track record in the market
  • Widely used by accountants and bookkeepers

Pricing

The core difference isn't a dollar figure — it's a structural one.

One Bill vs. Many

Accountium hasn't published set pricing tiers yet. The core difference in approach: QuickBooks prices by feature tier, with payroll and some advanced features sold as add-ons. Accountium is built around a single plan with everything included, so your bill doesn't grow every time you need another feature.

Want current pricing? Get in touch — no pricing page runaround. We'll give you a straight answer based on your business size.

Switching from QuickBooks

Moving your books over is a straightforward three-step process. Most businesses complete the migration in a single afternoon.

  • Export your data

    QuickBooks lets you export your chart of accounts, customer and vendor lists, and transaction history. A few clicks from the Reports or Settings menu.

  • Import into Accountium

    Bring that data into your new account and reconnect your bank feeds. Accountium's import tools handle the standard QuickBooks export formats directly.

  • Run a parallel period

    Most businesses run both systems for two to four weeks to confirm balances match before fully cutting over. This is optional but recommended.

Not a self-serve-only process Our team can walk through migration with you directly. If you have a complex chart of accounts or multi-entity setup, get in touch before you start — we'll map it out first.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from businesses comparing the two platforms.

  • Is Accountium cheaper than QuickBooks Online?

    Accountium hasn't published pricing yet. Unlike QuickBooks, which charges extra for payroll and some add-ons, Accountium is built around a single, all-inclusive plan with no per-feature upcharges. Get in touch for current pricing.

  • Does Accountium include payroll like QuickBooks?

    Yes. Payroll is built into Accountium's core suite alongside invoicing, banking, and reporting, rather than sold as a separate add-on tier.

  • Can I switch from QuickBooks to Accountium without losing data?

    You can export your chart of accounts, customers, vendors, and transaction history from QuickBooks and import them into Accountium. Our team can walk you through the migration.

  • Is Accountium good for accountants and bookkeepers, not just business owners?

    Accountium is built for both. QuickBooks has a longer track record and a larger network of certified accountants, so if your bookkeeper specifically requires QuickBooks, that's worth factoring in.

  • Does Accountium work for businesses outside Canada?

    Yes. Accountium is built for an international customer base, with multi-currency support and no dependency on Canada-specific tax rules in the core product.
